label: 网格→场景节点
description: 把 Mesh 挂成场景节点。地形必须走 heightfieldMesh.mesh → meshSceneNode。gridSceneNode 体素不是 mesh。
description-en: Hang a Mesh as a scene node. Required for terrain: heightfieldMesh.mesh → meshSceneNode. Voxels from gridSceneNode are not a mesh.

inputs.name: mesh
inputs.label: mesh
inputs.description: 要挂到节点上的三角网（heightfield_mesh 等）
inputs.description-en: Triangle mesh to hang on the node (from heightfield_mesh, etc.).

outputs.name: scene
outputs.label: scene
outputs.description: 单节点 scene，focus 指向新节点；可直接喂 add_child
outputs.description-en: One-node scene with focus on the new node; feed into add_child.

outputs.name: triangleCount
outputs.label: 三角形数
outputs.description-en: Number of triangles in the mesh.
